description: 不憫な女の子がすき FA→ #はよ見ろ一円

works.body:
Hello! I'm so excited for your skeb opening!

I wanted to ask for you to draw my OC, Alty! She's a fragment of a forgotten god who's been reccently revived. She's very chuuni and over confident, even though she often times has no idea what's going on around her or how things work. Sometimes she can appear a little intimidating, and she can sound ominous when she speaks seriously but she does her best to be helpful. Her powers consist of chains of light!

Please feel free to draw or customize her according to your vision and interpretation, and please feel free to resend if any adjustments are needed! Thank you!
